logline: After examining the dying Dowager Duchess's blackened fingernails and consulting her late mother's remedy journal, Lady Juliana discovers the Duchess is being poisoned with arsenic—only for someone to arrive at the bedroom door just as she begins concocting the antidote.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from the Episode 22 cliffhanger inside the forbidden West Wing of Ashbury Manor, where Lady Juliana crouches beside the bedridden Dowager Duchess, racing against time to determine the source of her fatal illness.

scenes.heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot through dark draped bed curtains into the shadowy bedchamber, showing Prudence keeping watch with a single candle while Lady Juliana sits beside the grand four-poster bed.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Prudence holding a brass candlestick with trembling hands, glancing nervously toward the doorway.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Anxious, Whispering)
events.content: "Juliana, we cannot stay for long. Someone will come."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Lady Juliana gently lifting the frail, trembling hands of the Dowager Duchess resting atop the linen covers.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana cradles the Duchess's frail hands in hers, inspecting her fingers with furrowed brows.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Duchess's fingertips, revealing pronounced dark, purplish-black discoloration beneath the nails.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Hushed, Grave)
events.content: "How long has she been like this?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Prudence leaning against the bedpost, tears glistening in her eyes.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Tearful, Trembling)
events.content: "Weeks."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: High-angle two-shot as Lady Juliana leans closer over the gasping Duchess, gently touching her parched lips.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Lady Juliana's concerned face as she withdraws her finger from the Duchess's mouth.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Solemn)
events.content: "Her mouth is terribly dry."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot as Lady Juliana presses her fingertips gently against the Duchess's wrist, feeling for a pulse.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Quiet, Grim)
events.content: "Her pulse is weak."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Prudence holding the flickering candle, crying openly in distress.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Despairing, Weeping)
events.content: "The physician said her heart is failing."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess gasping hoarsely for air, her throat straining as she weakly fights to breathe.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Duchess's raspy, labored inhalation.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Lady Juliana standing upright, her expression hardening with fierce skepticism.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Firm, Resolute)
events.content: "No."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot panning down as Juliana reaches into her deep apron pocket and pulls out a worn, leather-bound notebook.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Certain, Focused)
events.content: "This is not simply old age."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Quick reaction shot of Prudence staring with wide, bewildered eyes.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana sitting at the foot of the bed, carefully opening the leather journal across her lap and flipping through hand-annotated botanical pages.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up overhead of the yellowed parchment, showing botanical sketches of toxic herbs and handwritten diagnostic notes as Juliana's finger traces along the script.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana draws in a sharp, startled breath, her eyes widening in horror.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana looking up from the page, stunned by her mother's written words.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Breathless, Reverent)
events.content: "Mother."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Prudence leaning in, candle trembling.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Urgent, Baffled)
events.content: "What is it?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Two-shot of Juliana holding the open journal, reciting the matching symptoms to Prudence while the Duchess lies motionless in the background.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Shocked, Deliberate)
events.content: "Weakness. Dry mouth. The discoloration beneath the nails. The slow wasting."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Prudence staring back in stunned disbelief.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana speaking with absolute certainty.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Serious, Chilled)
events.content: "I have seen these symptoms before."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Prudence's terrified face.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Panicked, Shaken)
events.content: "What are you saying?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana's hands snapping the leather journal shut on the bedside table beside an oil lamp.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana resting her hands on the closed journal, looking squarely at Prudence.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Cold, Deadly Serious)
events.content: "Someone is poisoning her."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Prudence gasping sharply and clamping both hands over her mouth in sheer horror.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Sharp intake of breath from Prudence.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Muffled, Horrified)
events.content: "Poison?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up pushing in tight on Lady Juliana's eyes as her expression hardens into fury and righteous disgust.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Venomous, Resolute)
events.content: "Arsenic."

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Sudden violent coughing and sputtering from the Duchess.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot as the Duchess chokes and spasms on the bed; Juliana whips around immediately.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium tracking shot of Juliana rushing to the side table by the window, opening her satchel and setting out glass vials, a bowl, and dried herbal bundles.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Prudence pleading desperately, tears flowing down her cheeks.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Desperate, Begging)
events.content: "Can you save her?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana uncorking a glass apothecary bottle as the Duchess rests behind her.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Focused, Resolute)
events.content: "I can try."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Top-down close-up of Juliana's soot-smudged hands pouring powdered activated charcoal from a vial into a stone mortar, then tossing in a pinch of crushed dried leaves.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana's hands vigorously grinding the pestle inside the stone mortar.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Heavy, rhythmic scraping of stone pestle grinding charcoal and dried herbs.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana grinding intensely, her brow furrowed as she speaks with urgent authority.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Urgent, Focused)
events.content: "The charcoal may help remove what is still inside her. We must act quickly."

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Sudden muffled thump and heavy footsteps echoing from the hallway outside the door!

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot of the bedroom door framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess gasps in the bed.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana freezing mid-motion, turning her head sharply toward the chamber door.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the ornate brass door handle on the dark carved wooden door.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Prudence staring at the door in utter terror, her face drained of all color.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Terrified, Hoarse Whisper)
events.content: "Juliana... someone is coming."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Quick cut to Juliana looking back toward the bed and then toward the door, trapped with an unfinished cure.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of Juliana's charcoal-blackened hand clutching the glass medicine vial firmly.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Loud, metallic clack of the door latch turning, followed by the slow creak of wood hinges.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on the brass door lever as it slowly rotates downward, and the heavy door cracks open inward into the room—cutting to an intense, heart-stopping cliffhanger.
